description: Erection of side dormer roof extension, single storey side and rear extension with two front roof windows to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ((Amended) 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10 Received: 24/08/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.

Condition : 6 - During the construction of the single storey side extension hereby permitted, the trees located in the rear gardens of Grove Park Road houses shall be protected in line with BS 5837 (2012) 'Trees in Relation to Design, Demolition and Construction' and if necessary a qualified Arboriculturist advice shall be received and followed.
